newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG says sees 96/97 profit rising.
newsitem.headline: MG says sees 96/97 profit rising.

text.p: German diversified engineering and trading group Metallgesellschaft AG said on Monday it expected its earnings in the current 1996/1997 fiscal year to exceed the 1995/1996 result.

"No precise forecast can yet be made for the fiscal year. However we expect to beat the previous year's result," management board chairman Kajo Neukirchen said in a statement released ahead of the company's annual results news conference.

Neukirchen said an exact forecast was impossible because of MG may face substantial changes in its portfolio of shareholdings following the planned purchase of a 49.99 percent stake in industrial holding company AGIV.
The 20 percent rise in group pre-tax profit in the first quarter of 1996/1997 cannot be extrapolated into a full-year forecast, Neukirchen said.
